newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka edges up at close on dollar flow.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka edges up at close on dollar flow.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed up at 42.5480/5490 to the dollar in interbank trading, compared with the previous 42.5485/5495, dealers said.
Dealers said the local unit, which opened at the previous day's level, edged up as the dollar supply increased due mainly to the inflow of the currency through remittances from abroad.
Dealers said the interbank call money rates closed at 5.0 percent to 6.0 percent, against the previous close at 5.25 percent to 6.0 percent. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
